name: conductor

scripts.build: npm run build -w @conductor/core && npm run build -w @conductor/cli && npm run build -w conductor-vscode
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit && tsc -p packages/vscode --noEmit

description: Start multi-service dev environments in dependency order, waiting for each service to be ready.
author: Delaksan Sritharan
